inputSummary: Real Alice-to-Bob transfer with committed transaction, block-byte hash proof, later block, balance deltas, and sanitized evidence.

evidence.test: make test passed; real transfer committed at height 2 and a later block reached height 3.
evidence.transaction: Exactly one Alice-to-Bob MsgSend for 25000000ubaby with a 500ubaby fee and numeric code 0.
evidence.block: Expected chain ID and height matched; SHA-256 reproduced from .data.txs[] matched the transaction hash.
evidence.balances: Alice -25000500ubaby, Bob +25000000ubaby, validator liquid balance unchanged.
evidence.publication: Exactly eight validated JSON files replace the public evidence directory as one generation.
evidence.security: Malformed responses fail closed and public evidence contains no secret-bearing fields.

interventions: Repaired five review findings covering publication, block extraction, response codes, MsgSend semantics, and arithmetic input safety.
